definitions.explanation: The part of the arm between the shoulder and the elbow, often a focus of fitness and beauty discussions in Japanese.

examples.japanese: {二|に}の{腕|うで}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。

examples.english: In summer, I'm self-conscious about my upper arms.

examples.japanese: {二|に}の{腕|うで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{細|ほそ}く→細い：02962_hosoi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦エクササイズ→エクササイズ：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm doing exercises to slim down my upper arms.

examples.japanese: {二|に}の{腕|うで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦たるみ→たるみ：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦ノースリーブ→ノースリーブ：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{着|き}られない→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: I'm bothered by the flab on my upper arms and can't wear sleeveless tops.

examples.japanese: {二|に}の{腕|うで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{筋肉|きんにく}→筋肉：02646_kinniku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦ダンベル→ダンベル：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦トレーニング→トレーニング：00408_toreeningu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効果的|こうかてき}→効果的：04793_koukateki⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that dumbbell training is effective for building upper arm muscles.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY: {二|に}の{腕|うで} literally means "second arm," historically referring to the upper arm as opposed to the forearm (⟦{前腕|ぜんわん}→前腕：noentry⟧). In older Japanese, ⟦{一|いち}の{腕|うで}→一の腕：noentry⟧ referred to the forearm.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{二|に}の{腕|うで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦たるみ→たるみ：noentry⟧ (upper arm flab/sagging)
・{二|に}の{腕|うで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{締|し}める→引き締める：15264_hikishimeru⟧ (to tone the upper arms)
・{二|に}の{腕|うで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ダイエット→ダイエット：17678_daietto⟧ (diet/exercise for upper arms)
・{二|に}の{腕|うで}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{太|ふと}い→太い：02955_futoi⟧ (thick upper arms)
・{二|に}の{腕|うで}⟦シェイプ→シェイプ：noentry⟧ (upper arm shaping)

BODY IMAGE CONTEXT: In Japanese beauty culture, {二|に}の{腕|うで} often appears in discussions about appearance, especially regarding concerns about arm flab (⟦{振|ふ}り{袖|そで}→振袖：19967_furisode⟧ - "swinging sleeves" is a slang term for flabby upper arms).

・⟦{上腕|じょうわん}→上腕：noentry⟧ (upper arm - formal medical term)
・⟦{上腕二頭筋|じょうわんにとうきん}→上腕二頭筋：noentry⟧ (biceps)
・⟦{上腕三頭筋|じょうわんさんとうきん}→上腕三頭筋：noentry⟧ (triceps)
